title: oenanthe peucedanifolia subsp. silaifolia
intro:
Oenanthe peucedanifolia subsp. silaifolia, commonly known as Water Celery or Water Celery Fern, is a plant species within the Apiaceae family, characterized by its distinctive fern-like leaves and ability to thrive in aquatic environments.

This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce swelling, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oenanthe peucedanifolia subsp. silaifolia include its potential to ease symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, such as irritable bowel syndrome and gastritis, as well as its capacity to act as an anti-spasmodic agent, reducing muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include a variety of compounds, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
